distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: One detail: I transferred credits from a college overseas last autumn.
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have my prior-study records available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I am trying to finish enrolling for the coming term.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with that. Do you have your student reference?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it ends in six-two-two.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a locker on campus?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I do not need one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you studying full time or part time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Full time this year.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the contact number ending in eight-one-nine right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is correct.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like reminders before the deadline?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, reminders would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you require any study support arrangements?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you arranged your tuition payment method?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is all set up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is any of your prior study from outside the usual system?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One detail: I transferred credits from a college overseas last autumn.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is your term address the same as last year?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the same place.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you chosen all of your modules yet?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I picked them last week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you need a timetable sent to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that would be handy.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Put the enrolment through the automated registration run.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait for it to go through.

enrolment_status.not_submitted: the enrolment has not been submitted
enrolment_status.held_for_review: processing paused for manual review of prior study
enrolment_status.confirmed: the enrolment was accepted and confirmed

pre_gap_actions.description: Put the enrolment through the automated registration run.
Push the whole thing back to a later term instead.
Set aside the entry requirements entirely for this student.
Go back over the chosen modules before submitting.
Close the request and ask the student to try again.

post_gap_actions.description: Have the earlier qualifications formally evaluated before submitting again.
Send the identical enrolment through the run again now.
Go back over the chosen modules instead.
Leave the enrolment alone and wait another interval.
Close the request because the registration interval has passed.

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Where did the earlier study come from?
Is the student full time or part time?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
